subject: Service-to-VLAN evidence curation for Dedicated & Private deployments
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service-to-VLAN evidence curation for Dedicated & Private deployments

Team —

Greenline (security@greenline-analytics.com) has asked for a compact evidence bundle we can attach to their SIG/SOC2 packet. They want a single-page legend + annotated diagram that maps:

- customer-dedicated GPU pools (logical names) -> VLAN segments
- control-plane endpoints, ingress/egress breakouts and egress peering (cloud vs on-prem)
- prefix/KV cache placement and any shared services (metrics, observability collectors)
- explicit tenant boundary callouts (what is shared vs isolated)

I've attached a first-pass CSV (evidence_index_draft.csv) with rows for the items they asked about. Can you each review and clip the minimum set of artifacts we should send? Prefer a small curated set (<= 4 files) plus the one-page legend.

Specific asks:
- Kimberly: can you produce an annotated VLAN legend (mapping service role -> VLAN id, ACL intent) and a short paragraph describing how Dedicated pools are isolated at L2/L3? PDF preferred.
- Soojin: can you export a clean png of the current isolation diagram that shows control-plane vs data-plane connections for Private deployments? Include a small caption for the egress model.
- Marcus: quick confirmation on whether any observability collectors cross tenant boundaries (yes/no + explanation).

Goal: send a curated packet to audits@greenline-analytics.com by EOD Friday. If we can't hit that, let me know blockers.

Attachments: evidence_index_draft.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Infrastructure Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:05:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Service-to-VLAN evidence curation for Dedicated & Private deployments

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear ask. I'm attaching a draft VLAN legend (service-to-vlan-legend_v1.pdf) and a quick annotated diagram (isolation-diagram_v2.png). Draft notes below — I'll iterate after Soojin's PNG.

Highlights:
- Dedicated GPU pools: each Dedicated pool is mapped to an isolated L3 subnet and an associated VLAN for east-west enforcement at the private switch fabric. ACLs are applied on the leaf layer for tenant ingress and on the border routers for egress.
- Control plane: control-plane endpoints (management API, orchestration) are in a separate management VLAN with stricter egress filtering; these routes are reachable only via a management bastion or a curated peering used for telemetry.
- Shared services: logging and metric collectors are reachable over an observability VLAN but access is tokenized — collectors run per-region and pull metrics; there is no direct tenant-initiated connection into another tenant's compute.

Open qu: do we want to include an explicit example tenant mapping (e.g., customer-123 -> dp-vlan-307) in the packet? It makes the diagram more concrete but could increase the size of the artifact set.

Attachments: service-to-vlan-legend_v1.pdf (pdf), isolation-diagram_v2.png (png)

Kimberly Park
Security Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:22:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Service-to-VLAN evidence curation for Dedicated & Private deployments

On Wed, Jun 18, 2025 at 11:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Priyom —
> 
> Thanks for the clear ask. I'm attaching a draft VLAN legend...

I've exported a clean diagram and removed background artifacts; see service-map_screencap.dia.png attached. Caption (to include in packet):

"Private deployment (on-prem or VPC) uses a three-tier overlay: management VLAN, dedicated GPU pool VLANs (per-customer when Dedicated is selected), and shared observability VLAN. Egress for Private customers follows a curated peering in-region; for on-prem customers, egress may be NAT'd through the customer's edge appliance — annotated below."

Quick answers:
- Observability collectors: per-region collectors ingest metrics via a pull model and are deployed on an observability VLAN. They do not accept inbound flows from tenant instances (no cross-tenant inbound).
- On-prem differences: when a Private deployment is air-gapped, we mark egress as "customer-handled" and include the signed attestation in the packet instead of the standard egress peering diagram.

I will tidy captions and export a small PNG and a 1-page caption file if you want.

Attachments: service-map_screencap.dia.png (png)

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Platform Security, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:43:05 -0700
Subject: Final: curated evidence packet for Greenline (SOC2/SIG)

Team / Greenline audits —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal review I've curated the packet down to the following items we will send to Greenline as the initial evidence set:

1) service-to-vlan-legend_v1.pdf — one-page legend that maps roles to VLAN ids, ACL intent, and the short paragraph on L2/L3 isolation.
2) isolation-diagram_v2.png — annotated diagram showing control-plane vs data-plane and egress breakout.
3) service-map_screencap.dia.png — simplified topology used for the Private/on-prem footnote.
4) evidence_index_final.csv — small index with artifact descriptions (I'll attach below).

Notes/answers to their likely follow-ups:
- Observability collectors do not accept tenant-initiated inbound flows; they pull metrics.
- Dedicated pools are isolated by VLAN + L3 subnet + ACLs on leaf/border.
- For air-gapped/on-prem Private customers we will supply a signed attestation and mark egress as customer-handled.

Next steps: I'm attaching evidence_index_final.csv and will upload the same set to the shared drive: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/0ASampleSharedLink/evidence-pack (Greenline will get a share link with viewer-only access). Marcus — once you confirm the collector wording I will send to audits@greenline-analytics.com and loop Sales for billing/contract notes (HubSpot deal GL-4827).

Attachments: evidence_index_final.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Infrastructure Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
